# TapMenu Grand Resort & Spa

> TapMenu Grand Resort & Spa is a premier hotel and resort destination offering luxury accommodations, gourmet dining, and versatile event venues. Rooms start at ₹2,000 a night. Check-in and check-out are both at 11:00 AM. It has a pure vegetarian restaurant on the ground floor, an indoor banquet hall in the basement for around 120 guests and a large outdoor function lawn beside the building for around 1,500 to 2,000 guests.

Bookings are requests: guests send dates and room selection, and the hotel replies to confirm availability and the final price, including taxes.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the resort, rooms, dining, events, facilities, guest reviews and location.
- [Rooms](/rooms): Deluxe Room (king-size bed, ₹2,000 a night) and Super Deluxe Room (bed larger than king-size, ₹2,200 a night), each for up to 2 adults, with a comparison and room FAQs.
- [Weddings & Events](/weddings-events): Banquet hall (about 120 guests) and function lawn (1,500 to 2,000 guests) for weddings, receptions, and celebrations, with catering, guest rooms and event FAQs.
- [Dining](/dining): Multi-cuisine pure vegetarian dishes, tandoor breads, and fast food for breakfast, lunch and dinner, the full menu with prices in rupees, event catering and dining FAQs.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos of the facade, lobby, corridors, banquet hall, lighting and murals.
- [About & facilities](/about): The resort's design, every facility (restaurant, banquet hall, lawn, parking, lift, room service, laundry, power backup, CCTV, wheelchair access) and accessibility.
- [Contact, location, policies & FAQs](/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email, map and directions, plus check-in times, photo ID, payments, children, visitors, cancellation and booking questions.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): What details the site collects, how they are used and kept, and how to ask for deletion.

## Key facts

- Address: 100 Hospitality Boulevard, Grand Central Plaza, Metropolis, Metro State 100001, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 00000 00000, +91 00000 00001
- Email: contact@example.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/example
- Rooms: Deluxe ₹2,000 a night, Super Deluxe ₹2,200 a night, up to 2 adults each, extra bed on request. Taxes are added when the hotel confirms.
- In every room: air conditioning, Wi-Fi, TV, attached washroom, balcony, geyser, windows with curtains, extra pillows
- Check-in and check-out: 11:00 AM. A government-issued photo ID is needed for every adult.
- Payments: cash, UPI and cards
- Children and visitors are allowed.
- Cancellation: contact the hotel for cancellation and refund terms.
- Facilities: restaurant, banquet hall, function lawn, on-site parking, lift, room service, laundry, power backup, CCTV, wheelchair access.
- Restaurant: pure vegetarian (no meat, fish or egg). Menu prices are listed on the Dining page. Event package prices are shared on enquiry.
- Room rates are before taxes; the hotel adds taxes and any extra bed when it confirms.
